what: End-to-end: odg-policy-build-seam (calibrated resource policy) driving the EXISTING native-engineering-cycle.runNativeCycle over a reliable task class, cheap-policy (3b/maxRepair1) vs max-policy (7b/maxRepair3).
finding: For a CALIBRATED-reliable class the policy picks cheap (3b/1) and achieves the SAME acceptance (2/2) as the max policy (7b/3) at 1.96x less wall-clock (10629ms vs 20794ms) — a real adaptive-resource efficiency gain (§6: avoid spending the large model where the small one is reliable). The INDEPENDENT verifier arbitrated acceptance in both runs (no inflation). This exercises the WIRED loop end-to-end: calibrated-P → execution-policy → native-engineering-cycle deps.build seam → buildProject → independent verification.
